propositions: Nested pytest child omits caller-owned --basetemp and joins user-global numbered temp root, causing pytest session finish to synchronously scan and delete stale entries that can exceed the fixed 90-second communicate timeout after the test reports 100%.

Controlled A/B with 400,000 poisoned entries showed shared-root child took 10.8s cleanup vs private-basetemp child took 0.882s, proving cleanup cost scales with retained entries and the mechanism is the post-100% pytest session-finish stack in cleanup_numbered_dir.

Private basetemp repair passed 25/25 real nested-pytest runs without timeout while shared root remained unchanged, and held-out regression oracle GREEN after fix and RED after omitted-basetemp mutation, confirming isolation invariant.
